name: raise-escalation-threshold
description: Raise the churn-risk escalation threshold from $5,000 to $10,000 ARR in the canonical escalation-criteria fragment. The declared graph only reaches escalation-writer; triage-router paraphrases the old threshold in its local routing-rules fragment and silently keeps routing on $5k — the sync agent must infer that edge and propose the fix.

steps.find: churn risk on an account worth more than $5,000 ARR
steps.replace: churn risk on an account worth more than $10,000 ARR

inferenceMustFind.contradiction: routing-rules still says 'roughly $5k+ in yearly spend'; canonical criteria now says $10,000 ARR

demo.before: triage-router routes the $7k churn ticket to escalation (old $5k rule)
demo.after: once the inferred proposal for routing-rules is approved, triage-router routes the same ticket to billing — $7k is below the new $10k threshold
